_comment: One line per object. The header (prompt-header.txt) carries the shared look; the item line says only what is different. Keep every item in one batch so they share a look; regenerate a single item by name.

items.parcel: a cardboard parcel with a strip of tape and a small label with four bars, slightly squashed corners
items.scanner: a chunky arch-shaped scanner gate, slate blue, one round red lamp on top, open underneath
items.bin-a: a low open crate, sage green, empty, seen from slightly above
items.bin-b: a low open crate, terracotta, empty, seen from slightly above
items.slat: one flat belt slat, a thin wide rounded bar, slate grey, seen from above
